system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

ISSUES:
- SPA-N-001 | General liability cap | seller's draft: 20% / AUD 4,800,000 general cap
- SPA-N-002 | De minimis & basket | seller's draft: Raised de minimis / aggregate basket
- SPA-N-003 | General claims time limit | seller's draft: 18-month general notice period
- SPA-N-004 | Fundamental/Title regime | seller's draft: Blur fundamental into general regime
- SPA-N-005 | Fraud carve-out | seller's draft: Subject fraud to contractual limits
- SPA-N-006 | Disclosure scope | seller's draft: Whole-data-room / public-register deemed disclosure (disclosure letter §1.1-1.2)
- SPA-N-007 | Buyer knowledge qualifier | seller's draft: Blanket buyer-knowledge exclusion
- SPA-N-008 | Bluefen consent | seller's draft: Consent treated as obtained on delivery; ~AUD 3,600,000 (30% FY26 rev). AUD 75k payment unverified.
- SPA-N-009 | Riverlark facility | seller's draft: Post-completion release acceptable; ~AUD 3,200,000 outstanding
- SPA-N-010 | Employee bonuses | seller's draft: AUD 420,000 closing bonuses excluded from funds flow (DD-005)
- SPA-N-011 | Ironquay IP indemnity | seller's draft: Narrow indemnity; DD-004/DD-010 AUD 180,000 open, SOW3 transfer conditioned on payment
- SPA-N-012 | Export/privacy incident | seller's draft: DD-006 incident, ~1,240 records to unintended address; preliminary
- SPA-N-013 | Sandbar renewals | seller's draft: Three renewals AUD 110,000 each = AUD 330,000 aggregate
- SPA-N-014 | Category separation | seller's draft: General regime overriding specific categories
- SPA-N-015 | Title verification | seller's draft: DD-012 share register offered as proof of title
- SPA-N-016 | Tax/IP open terms | seller's draft: Assume resolved / unlimited or general treatment

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
**Buyer-side review — Project Kestrel**

| Issue | Seller’s position | Buyer should want | Recommendation / reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| **SPA-N-001: General liability cap** | Aggregate general warranty liability capped at **AUD 4.8m (20% of price)**. | Higher cap, preferably **50% of price** (or 100% as opening position). | **Reject as drafted; seek 50%.** The disclosed operational and compliance risks are material relative to a 20% cap. |
| **SPA-N-002: De minimis & basket** | AUD 25,000 per claim; AUD 250,000 basket; only excess above basket recoverable. | Lower de minimis, smaller basket, and a **tipping basket** once crossed. | **Seek AUD 10,000 de minimis and AUD 120,000 tipping basket.** Seller’s structure leaves numerous aggregate losses unrecoverable. |
| **SPA-N-003: General claims time limit** | Claims must be notified within **18 months**; proposed to apply broadly to all claims. | At least **24 months**, with tax, employment, privacy and other regulatory claims tied to applicable statutory periods. | **Seek 24 months and claim-preservation wording.** Eighteen months is short for latent SaaS, privacy and tax issues. |
| **SPA-N-004: Fundamental/Title regime** | Capacity and title warranties subject to the general cap and 18-month limit. | Title, capacity and authority outside the general cap and surviving for a substantially longer period; title ideally uncapped. | **Reject; make title/fundamental claims uncapped or separately capped at 100% and long-stop at least 6 years.** A buyer must receive what it paid for. |
| **SPA-N-005: Fraud carve-out** | No express carve-out; limitations, non-reliance and exclusive remedy provisions purportedly apply to all claims. | Fraud, fraudulent misrepresentation, wilful misconduct and deliberate concealment excluded from all caps, baskets, exclusions and non-reliance provisions. | **Require an express carve-out.** Contractual limitations should not protect fraud. |
| **SPA-N-006: Disclosure scope** | Blanket disclosure of the entire data room, accounts, registers and public records, plus specific disclosures. | Fair disclosure limited to matters **fairly disclosed with sufficient detail**; no blanket data-room/public-register disclosure. | **Reject general disclosure as drafted.** It could convert scattered or obscure documents into a defence to warranty claims. |
| **SPA-N-007: Buyer knowledge qualifier** | No claim for anything known or discoverable by Buyer or advisers, including from the data room/public records. | Limit to actual knowledge of named senior Buyer personnel, without constructive or adviser knowledge; no waiver for fraud or specific indemnities. | **Reject constructive knowledge.** “Discoverable” is uncertain and improperly shifts diligence risk to Buyer. |
| **SPA-N-008: Bluefen consent** | Consent not yet provided; Seller will use reasonable endeavours and treat delivery of written consent as satisfaction. | Consent and all clause 11.3 conditions as a **condition precedent to Completion**, with termination/indemnity rights. | **Do not complete without final unconditional consent.** Bluefen represents approximately 30% of FY26 revenue and is a major continuity risk. |
| **SPA-N-009: Riverlark facility** | Approximately AUD 3.2m remains outstanding; release/discharge to follow Completion. | Full repayment before or at Completion, release of security and evidence of discharge delivered at Completion. | **Make pre-Completion repayment and releases mandatory.** It is inconsistent with debt-free/cash-free delivery to defer debt release. |
| **SPA-N-010: Employee bonuses** | AUD 420,000 conditional Completion bonuses omitted from funds flow; payroll tax, super and on-costs unclear. | Seller-funded payment and all associated on-costs before/at Completion, or purchase-price adjustment/indemnity; written employee confirmations. | **Require grossed-up Seller payment or dollar-for-dollar adjustment.** Otherwise Buyer inherits an undisclosed transaction liability. |
| **SPA-N-011: Ironquay IP indemnity** | Existing indemnity limited to the specific SOW3 payment; AUD 180,000 remains open and no assignment/payment evidence exists. | Completion transfer of all Project Materials, supported by payment evidence, with a specific indemnity for non-transfer, infringement and remediation costs. | **Expand and condition Completion on IP transfer.** The current indemnity may not secure ownership or cover consequential remediation. |
| **SPA-N-012: Export/privacy incident** | Preliminary incident involving potentially 1,240 records; scope, access and notification obligations unresolved; no materiality admitted. | Specific indemnity covering investigation, notification, remediation, regulatory action, claims and losses, outside general limits; continuing cooperation. | **Seek a specific uncapped or separately capped indemnity and escrow/retention.** The liability is unquantified and may crystallise after Completion. |
| **SPA-N-013: Sandbar renewals** | Three renewals totalling AUD 330,000 treated as ordinary-course costs. | Details of term, termination, accrual and necessity; no renewal without consent; adjustment/indemnity for pre-Completion commitments. | **Require confirmation and price adjustment or Seller discharge.** The disclosure does not establish that the costs are ordinary-course or unavoidable. |
| **SPA-N-014: Category separation** | All Claims subject to the same caps, time limits, exclusive-remedy and non-reliance regime. | Separate regimes for general warranties, title/fundamental warranties, tax, IP, privacy, debt, leakage and specific indemnities. | **Reject uniform treatment.** Risk-specific liabilities require tailored caps, survival periods and remedies. |
| **SPA-N-015: Title verification** | Seller relies on the share register showing Harbourglass holds 100%; Buyer’s independent verification is not addressed. | Evidence of legal and beneficial ownership, fully paid shares, no encumbrances/options/trusts, updated ASIC/share-register searches and Seller authority. | **Require a title deliverables package and fundamental warranty.** A share register alone does not eliminate competing ownership or encumbrance risk. |
| **SPA-N-016: Tax/IP open terms** | Seller says tax and IP are settled under the general regime; no special protection proposed. | Specific tax covenant/indemnity and robust IP warranties/indemnity, outside the general cap and with appropriate survival. | **Keep these expressly open and negotiate dedicated protections.** Tax and IP exposures can be latent, high-value and unsuitable for a short general warranty regime. |

**Overall recommendation:** do not accept the Seller’s “FINAL” labels as binding. The disclosed matters justify a revised risk-allocation package, completion conditions for Bluefen/Riverlark/Ironquay, and specific indemnities for bonuses, privacy, tax and IP.
=== END ADVICE ===
